name: Phil Hartman
title: Last known photo of Phil Hartman, taken with Marc Graue at Graue's studio in Burbank, California, on May 25, 1998, three days before his death.
description: This photograph shows Phil Hartman (left) with Marc Graue at Graue's studio in Burbank, California, on May 25, 1998. Hartman had spent the day there. In 2020, Graue shared the photo on Instagram, writing that he "was lucky enough to spend the day with the amazing Phil Hartman" three days before he was killed, and remembered him as "funny, down to earth and a genuinely nice guy." At the time, Hartman's marriage to Brynn Omdahl was under severe strain because of her struggles with substance abuse, and reports indicate she had recently relapsed. In the early morning hours of May 28, 1998, Brynn shot and killed Phil as he slept in their Encino home, then died by suicide hours later. He was 49 years old.
bio: Phil Hartman was an American comedian, actor, screenwriter, and graphic designer. Best known for his eight seasons on Saturday Night Live, his starring role as Bill McNeal on NewsRadio, and voice work on The Simpsons as Troy McClure and Lionel Hutz.
